scope.reason_v1_is_open: The legacy all-at-once Draft route is deliberately disabled. This package must not invent or reactivate it. Equivalent fresh V1-versus-V8 universes remain a separate blocking gate until an authorised historical oracle exists.

policy_invariants: A reversal-and-replacement correction is one atomic lifecycle unit with exactly one reversal and exactly one replacement.
A reversal-only correction is one atomic lifecycle unit with exactly one reversal and no replacement.
A canonical cancellation can create a genuine REVERSAL_ONLY unit directly; this is different from a REVERSAL_REPLACEMENT unit whose replacement row has merely disappeared.
A replacement-only remnant is always invalid because every valid correction unit requires exactly one reversal.

The current standard delete owner removes a valid changed-hours reversal/replacement pair as one exact two-row unit when deletion is allowed; retained financial history may instead require the existing archive path.

The current standard delete owner does not convert a two-member changed-hours unit into REVERSAL_ONLY when only its replacement is to be removed. That user-required transition is an upstream lifecycle gap and must not be approximated by weakening Draft validation.

Only every exact member of a fully valid authoritative import-correction family is exempted from conflicting with another member of that same family; ordinary and unrelated overlaps remain prohibited.
The physical leg identities and ordered member identities remain explicit; the pair is never collapsed into one invented Timesheet.
The correction residual owner alone calculates the TS_DAY residual and applies Policy X settled and reserved evidence.

A reversal-only negative residual enters the existing overpayment recovery handoff with its exact correction-chain evidence; it is not paid as a negative Timesheet and cannot become a Draft deduction without the existing recovery-headroom owner.
PAYE and Umbrella source amounts are never converted by the fixture. Cross-channel conversion remains blocked until the exact saved resolution fingerprint is present and current.
Paid, invoiced, broken, duplicate, mixed-identity and stale-fingerprint shapes fail closed without creating Draft, payment, provider, settlement or remittance state.
Current V8 row-backed transport may carry the certified typed constituent but may not recalculate its amount, identity, channel or policy evidence.

pass_rule: All 11 class rows must have PG17 and PG18 rollback-contained results. Positive rows require exact typed current-V8 artifacts; negative rows require their exact error or block plus zero-write and unrelated-Candidate equality. Reversal-only rows additionally require the exact existing OVERPAYMENT handoff here and the separately bound P4 zero-headroom Draft exclusion on both channels. Source guards must preserve the four distinct member-deletion outcomes and must keep the replacement-only-to-REVERSAL_ONLY gap explicit rather than weakening Draft validation. This still does not close true V1-versus-V8 parity.
